The Dragon's Gift

Wei Chen was an ordinary farmer in the village of Qinghe. Every morning he tended his rice paddies, and every evening he returned to his small house at the edge of the forest. He was content, but secretly longed for something greater.

One autumn day, while clearing brush near the old mountain cave, Wei Chen stumbled upon a large jade-green egg, warm to the touch and faintly glowing. The village elder, Grandma Liu, warned him to leave it — dragon eggs brought either great fortune or terrible ruin. But Wei Chen could not abandon it.

He took the egg home and kept it by the hearth. Three days later it cracked open, revealing a tiny silver dragon who looked at Wei Chen with gold eyes full of ancient wisdom. Wei Chen named her Yinzhu — Silver Pearl. From that day forward, the two were inseparable, and the fate of Qinghe was forever changed.
